title: I've tried every single iPhone currently available - here's my ranking of the 7 iPhones you can buy right now (AAPL)
text: I’ve tried every single iPhone currently available — here’s my ranking of the 7 iPhones you can buy right now (AAPL) By Avery Hartmans Nov 17, 2018, 7:45 am 27 pts If you want to buy an iPhone right now, you have seven different options to choose from. From the brand-new, futuristic iPhone XS to the old-but-good iPhone 7, the current iPhone lineup has a range of devices and price points. At this point, I've tried all seven of Apple's current iPhones. And…
